assessments.reason: The release broadens from the disputed shipment to "all claims arising from any shipment handled by Respondent before execution", and drops the carve-out for unrelated shipments, so Zelmivale would give up unrelated claims for the same $180,000. The freight-charge release by Respondent remains tied to the same shipment.
assessments.quote: all claims arising from any shipment handled by Respondent before execution

counter.replace: claims arising from the disputed shipment and its handling before execution. The release does not extend to obligations created by this agreement or shipments unrelated to the display units.

assessments.reason: The preservation paragraph is only moved to Section 8, with identical text: "The parties shall preserve the delivery photographs, tracking records, and joint inspection notes for two years after execution."

assessments.reason: Respondent's packaging account is due sooner, "within ten days after execution", which slightly benefits Zelmivale as the recipient, though it is minor and the day count is unspecified.
